prompt:
Advertisements aimed directly at young children appear on screens, inside games and in public places. Some people believe that this kind of advertising should not be permitted at all.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: The task expects a clear position: agree / disagree / partly agree
The real question is the outright-ban dimension — simply saying advertising affects children is not enough
At least two reasons plus concrete examples: young children cannot tell persuasive intent apart, and it creates spending pressure on families

A brief acknowledgement of the opposing view is expected: advertising revenue keeps free content running and some responsibility for oversight falls on families; instead of a total ban, limits on timing, medium, or content could be argued for
The position should be restated clearly at the end
common_mistakes: Skipping the ban dimension and just writing that 'there is a lot of advertising'
Listing both sides without stating a position
Writing only in emotional language without giving reasons or examples
